name: Onboarding Checklist
description: Guided onboarding checklist for new users; surfaced in-app on first login with progress indicators.

name: Referral Program
description: Two-sided referral with reward credits; requires invite flow, credit wallet, and notifications.

name: Usage-Based Billing Tier
description: Add a pay-per-use tier below the starter plan to reduce CAC for SMB/prosumer segment.

name: Bulk CSV Import
description: Allow users to import up to 10,000 records via CSV with field mapping and dedup.

name: API Rate-Limit Increase
description: Raise default API rate limit from 60 to 300 req/min for Pro+ plans; infra sharding required.

name: AI-Powered Smart Search
description: Embed semantic search across all user content using vector index; replaces keyword-only search.

name: Annual Plan Upsell Prompt
description: In-app nudge at day 45 offering 20% discount on annual plan; A/B tested copy.

name: SOC 2 Type II Audit
description: Complete SOC 2 Type II readiness: policy docs, vendor assessments, pen-test, audit engagement.

name: Mobile Push Notifications
description: Re-engagement push notifications for iOS/Android; personalised digest of pending action items.

name: Slack Integration
description: Bidirectional Slack integration: post updates to channels and create items from Slack commands.
